facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Media's permanent secretary says the Access to Information Act came into force on 25 June 2025 after the minister signed a commencement order.
The permanent secretary says the Access to Information Regulations, 2025 (SI No. 56 of 2025) were signed on 29 August 2025.

The permanent secretary says the Access to Information Guidelines were published on 5 December 2025 through Gazette Notice No. 1624 of 2025; the Act's rules were still being finalised by the Ministry of Justice for the Chief Justice's signature in July 2026.
